descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT și Dezvoltare de software
About Us: 
 20 years on the Romanian IT market and still growing.
 Part of the HN Services Group, with offices in France, Spain, Portugal, and Luxembourg, HN Services Romania is about building real careers, not just filling roles . 
 What you’ll find here: 
Digital transformation projects with real impact
A wide range of technical roles across modern and legacy technologies (yes, COBOL is still very much alive)
Exposure to diverse industries and international environments
Continuous growth through our in-house software development training center (HN Training Institute)
 💡We are looking for a Senior FullStack Engineer to join our dynamic team!
 Key responsibilities: 
Plan, develop and implement projects or parts of large-scale projects as part of the development team
Responsible of solving complex problems and exposed to a variety of challenges, from technical solutions and design to improving service delivery from an end-to-end perspective
Understand and evaluate complex data models
Develop solutions to improve performance and scalability of systems
Implement the company development guidelines and processes and come with improvement suggestions
Is responsible for analysis / evaluation / implementation of the technical solution(s) defined for his allocated project or within the support zone
Acts as a mentor and technical coordinator, guiding the development team during the software development life cycle
Deliver scalable end‑to‑end solutions by seamlessly integrating front-end user experience with robust backend systems.
 What we are looking for: 
Experience: minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Java development with a mix of Front and Backend development.
 The job involves 70% Frontend and 30% Backend tasks .
 Practical knowledge of: 
Advanced technical knowledge in Angular
Practical technical knowledge in Spring Boot, Spring Data/JPA
 Practical knowledge in at least three areas from the list below: 
REST / WS
HTML5 + CSS3 / JavaScript / JQuery
Linux / JBoss
PostgreSQL
 Daily use of one of the following tools: 
IDE: Eclipse / NetBeans / InteliJ
Repository: SVN / Git / Mercurial
Build: Hudson / Jenkins / Maven
Test: JUnit / Teamcity / Fitnesse
Web Services using WCF (SOAP) and Web APIs (REST)
 Other Skills: 
SQL, XML, JSON, Domain Driven Design
IBM Cloud knowledge, Postgres, Kafka/RabbitMQ, vertical slice architecture knowledge – would be a plus
 We are also interested in: 
Attention to detail and analytical qualities
Good communication skills
Language skills: English (written / verbal) - Advanced level
Team player mentality: ability and willingness to collaborate and support in a global team
Self-driven, suggests ideas, has initiative
Ability to work autonomously
 *Only eligible candidates will be contacted for further information and start of the recruitment process.
